title: On One Condition: Siempre Que and Con Tal de Que
goal: Set the terms of an agreement with siempre que, con tal de que and a condición de que plus the subjunctive.

items: I can set a condition with siempre que, con tal de que and a condición de que.
I can use the infinitive after con tal de and a condición de when both clauses share a subject.
I can use the new words for contracts and terms.
